## Activity

During June 2023, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 88 captures. The figure represents the total capture activity reported for the month. This report provides a concise account of activity, image quality and grading outcomes for the site. The activity total is presented alongside the quality and grading measures below to support review of the month’s performance.

## Image quality

Of the 88 captures, 2 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 2.3. This measure provides the reported proportion of captures that could not be graded. The image quality result should be considered together with the overall capture total and the grading results recorded for June 2023.

## Grading

The grading record shows 11 referable results. The median_lag was 1. Together, these figures summarise the reported grading outcome and the time associated with grading during June 2023. The results provide the available site-level view of referable findings and grading timeliness for the month.
